error.message: Sandbox '<sandbox>' cannot be resumed with its memory: its snapshot was taken while the sandbox guest agent was not responding, and resuming the memory would bring that back. Resume it without memory (memory: false) to cold-boot it from its disk. Resume the sandbox with `onResume: 'reboot'`.
